ModMetaData.name: VPE - Tilling Uses Plant Work Speed
ModMetaData.author: Igor José Silveira Martins
ModMetaData.description:
In Vanilla Plants Expanded, tilling soil is a Growing job that uses the Plants skill, but its work speed still comes from the colonist's Construction Speed. This mod makes tilling use Plant Work Speed instead.
- Only tilling is affected. Walls, floors and every other construction job are unchanged. - The skill requirement and XP were already handled by Vanilla Expanded Framework (Plants) and stay the same. - No construction stuff factor is applied to tilling. - Compatible with Vanilla Skills Expanded: its Floor Speed stat no longer applies to tilling (other floors keep it). - Heads-up: low-skill growers will till slower and skilled growers faster than before.
Requires Harmony and Vanilla Plants Expanded. Load after Vanilla Plants Expanded. Safe to add to or remove from existing saves: it only changes code at runtime and adds no new Defs.
